description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM upgrade process, specifically handling the cancellation of an upgrade step. It includes security checks, logging, cleanup operations such as deleting temporary files and resetting session data, and generates an HTML output for the user interface with buttons for restarting or exiting the upgrade.
external_files: None explicitly included in the snippet, but references to configuration and session data imply dependencies on SuiteCRM's core files, session management, and configuration files.
